suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 (GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp) is unsafe deserialization in the Kotlin Gradle plugin build cache (affected package org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin, fixed 2.4.20-Beta1). kotlin-stdlib only matches the broad cpe:jetbrains:kotlin; Sangam does not ship or run the Gradle plugin. Reviewed 2026-11-08.

CVE-2026-0994 (GHSA-7gcm-g887-7qv7) is a JSON recursion-depth bypass in the Python protobuf package (PyPI protobuf, fixed 5.29.6 / 6.33.5); protobuf-java only matches the generic cpe:google:protobuf. Reviewed 2026-11-08.
